candidate.title: Succinate Dehydrogenase B (SDHB) Overexpression with Enzymatic Dysfunction Defines a Distinct Subtype of Undifferentiated Pleomorphic Sarcoma.

choice_basis: Recent primary explicitly measures enzyme function rather than inferring it from RNA. Broader native sarcoma/pathology controls might establish a useful unassessed orthogonal EMC assay; neither native EMC eligibility nor favorable biology is assumed. Chosen from title/method premise only, before abstract/body/endpoints.
conditional_question: If authentic native EMC is linked to actual direct complex-II enzymatic measurements, does its measured function versus protein abundance differ from same-assay UPS and normal/nonmalignant controls in a way that changes whether abundance can guide a metabolic localization/activity experiment?
published_prior_art: The authors already establish an SDHB-expression/function relationship in their selected UPS subtype. That is prior art, not a new EMC finding. New value requires an unanswered EMC-specific controlled addition beyond their reported comparator result.
required_fields_before_values: All native EMC pathology/model/donor labels with source authentication
Every EMC tissue/culture/intervention/technical condition and repeated donor
Direct enzyme method/units/protein normalization and blank/positive control
Protein-abundance assay versus direct activity linked in same specimen/model
Comparator source identity and identical handling/exposure
Public numeric endpoint location and source-column mapping
strongest_alternative: Only UPS or generic sarcoma/other models were assayed, or EMC appears in protein staining without direct enzyme measurement; protein expression need not establish functional complex-II state.
defeat_stop: No native EMC-linked direct assay/controlled public condition matrix or useful unreported addition means NO-GO before values. Already reported exact EMC comparative result also defeats standalone value.
permitted_projection: Primary title/identity, section titles, selected nonnumeric method/assay-schema/availability text and exact diagnosis/model labels only. No abstract/results measurements, CNA/sequence/STR/structural/denied mechanisms or outcome columns.
